text:
Priya N: Just uploaded the near-final launch post. Need quick checks  headline, benchmark box, legal-safe residency language, and inbound form/workflow for webinar signups. Link in doc.

Calvin S: Quick skim  headline option: 'Inference that behaves like infrastructure'  alt: 'Predictable inference for production'. Either works. For benchmarks: please use explicit medians + percentiles and include test conditions. e.g., median 228ms, p95 512ms at 1k tokens (NVIDIA A100, batch=8).

Jules M: Product: add one sentence in the hero about rollout controls (pin versions, canary rollback). Also add a small hosted vs dedicated 2-bullet compare below the fold.

Ravi K: Legal: cannot claim absolute data guarantees. Replace "we never see customer inputs" with "customers may choose dedicated deployments or VPC peering to meet data residency and isolation requirements." Also require the eval PDF uploaded to /legal/audit before publish for audit trail.

Priya N: will update residency line and add rollout sentence. Adding Calvin's benchmark numbers into the tech callout now.

Nora Q: Ops rec: publish Tuesday 09:00 PT, webinar Thursday 11:00 PT (48h lead time). I'll create the HubSpot form and wire hidden fields campaign=prod_launch_fall2026 and source=blog. Add checkbox 'send_eval' to trigger the eval-delivery workflow.

Calvin S: Product ok with benchmark phrasing and hero tweak. Small edit: hero image alt should mention 'Redwood Inference dashboard'.

Ravi K: Legal will sign off once the eval artifact is uploaded. Please include checksum or S3 path in the doc. Also avoid the phrase 'enterprise-grade' without a feature link.

Priya N: uploaded eval to /legal/audit/2837465599_eval.pdf (sha256: 0f3a9...placeholder) and linked it in the draft. Reworded residency sentence and removed 'enterprise-grade' from the hero.

Ravi K: confirmed artifact present. Legal sign-off granted.

Nora Q: HubSpot form created at https://hubspot.forms/launch-2837. Mapping: list 'Launch_Fall_2026', tags ['source:blog','interest:eval'], hidden fields as above. Workflow: if send_eval=true then email S3 link and add to nurture sequence. I'll post embed snippet shortly.

Jules M: Product sign-off final.

Calvin S: Approving headline: 'Inference that behaves like infrastructure'. Tiny nit: in the benchmark box please note hardware + batch exactly as Calvin suggested.

Priya N: thanks all. @publish-bot can you schedule CMS publish for 2026-11-02T09:00:00-07:00 and connect the HubSpot webhook to the form URL above? Also schedule the webinar for 2026-11-04T11:00:00-07:00.

publish-bot: Scheduled: Post 'Inference that behaves like infrastructure' set to publish 2026-11-02 09:00 PDT. HubSpot webhook configured; webinar scheduled for 2026-11-04 11:00 PDT.

Priya N: final checklist: headline locked, benchmark callout with test conditions, legal artifact uploaded, HubSpot mapping live. If no objections I'll press publish on Tuesday. :rocket:
